content:
Maya: Quick sketch idea 3 legend shows small motto: "units & precision" inline with series name, expanding to a thin panel. Trying to reduce axis clutter and make formatting explicit.
Liam: Could we instead show the units icon next to the series color swatch and open small popover on click?
Olivia: If popover, ensure focus management and role/menu semantics. Also, use "units" not "precision" for labels in the popover header.
Sam: Backend needs to persist per-series overrides. Proposed JSON: {"displaySettings": {"overrides": {"latency": {"unit": "ms", "precision": 2}}}}
Maya: For outlier handling default to "fade" and show a caret on axis when capping occurs.
Liam: Tooltip copy: "Axis capped at 99th percentile when capping enabled".
Olivia: aria-label example: "Open units menu for latency series. Current unit: milliseconds."
Maya: I'll post Figma link later. Action: Olivia drafts aria strings, Sam wires minimal API, Liam finalizes hover copy.
Maya: closing unless objections :thumbsup:
